summary: Manual test fire of the dispatcher (run: cloud-kinz-improvement), separate from today's earlier scheduled run (PR #23). Full pytest/ruff/verify_readonly suite was clean on main before starting. An Opus subagent audit found 3 real issues; picked the highest-confidence one that does not change any reported figure: 5 generated passages (EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY priority bullet, financial_analysis.md DSO action, sales_analysis.md payment-status interpretation, regulatory_recommendations.md AR-collection block, strategic_recommendations.md estimated-impact line) kept unconditional 'collection crisis' wording regardless of the extract, contradicting build_collection_risk()'s already-tiered verdict elsewhere in the same run (on the real extract A/R is 0.00 TND, and these five said follow up on 0 TND, consider legal action, and framed a DSO reduction as freeing '~0 TND'). Added 5 tiered pure functions to report_builders.py reusing the existing ar_risk_tier(), wired them into generate_reports.py at all five sites, added unit + source-guard tests, verified by running process_data.py + generate_reports.py against the real committed extract and reading the regenerated text, then reverted the regenerated output before committing. 373 tests pass, ruff clean, read-only verifier clean, CI green, merged as PR #24 (squash). Two lower-value findings from the same audit were left for a future run: draft/cancelled Odoo sale orders inflating product_sales.csv (a figure-changing fix, would need the hold label + NEEDS YOU per the tightened rule), and a mislabelled 'Total Payments Received' figure that includes outbound supplier payments (also figure-changing) plus a stale CLAUDE.md claim about extract_shopify_orders.py being standalone. Note: the audit subagent's first attempt was terminated by an Opus session-wide rate limit (reset ~00:30 UTC) after it had already produced its full report in the hand-back message, so no retry was needed; the fix itself was done directly (no further Opus escalation) since it only threads already-correct derived values through more locations via the same established tiering pattern, not new figure derivation.
